subject: Reminder: Upcoming Payment Due for Your Subscription
body: Hello, We hope this email finds you well. We would like to remind you that the payment for your subscription is due in 3 days. Please ensure that your payment information is up to date to avoid any interruptions to your service. Thank you for choosing our service and we appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team.
